integrity: The infinite-family statement follows from elementary exact subset support inequalities; finite rational computations are corroboration only. The literature comparison is not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is for the specified unweighted simplex-sum realization of the star graph associahedron. It does not apply to arbitrary deformations or differently weighted nestohedra. Earlier equivalent statements under other terminology cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry and unique center of simplex-sum stellohedra
